content: Nothing great was ever achieved without enthusiasm.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: The word 'enthusiasm' stems from the Greek 'entheos'—divinely inspired. True greatness requires the vibrant, joyful fire of authentic passion.
practicalInsight: Bring genuine warmth and vibrant enthusiasm to even the simplest task on your agenda today.
reflectionPrompt: What endeavor in your life deserves your full, wholehearted enthusiasm?
